messages:
amy: FYI p95 jumped ~2.2x on prod-rt-eu cluster starting 1791234500, saw immediate kernel fallback to 'sgemm_v2' in logs. Not getting spans for those requests though :confused:
observability-bot: Alert: latency_threshold_exceeded prod-rt-eu p95=482ms (>200ms) at 1791234510
raj: Can you paste the runtime logs around that time? I'm seeing some kernel fingerprints in the profiler that don't match the kernel catalog
maria: logs attached — but note log-sampler dropped many debug lines. we only have INFO and WARN
noah: quick note — this cluster had a noisy neighbor on node rt-12 yesterday, possible cache thrash
amy: snippet:
```
[1791234511] kernel_fingerprint=0x7f2a3b sgd: selected kernel sgemm_v2 (heuristic mismatch)
[1791234512] kv_cache: evict shard=42 reason=noise_detected
```
raj: profiler flamegraph shows softmax and attention_kernel spikes. also batches are tiny — batching heuristic misclassified incoming tokens, seq_len spikes
maria: dashboard mismatch: "per-route latency" shows a 20% drop in throughput but "gpu utilization" chart doesn't move. traces missing = we can't correlate
amy: I think two gaps: 1) trace/log sampling too aggressive during alert window 2) batcher heuristics regressed after last deploy (kernel fingerprint mismatch)
raj: repro steps I'm running: increase trace sampling to 100% for 10m on prod-rt-eu, enable full debug logs on a canary node rt-canary-3
observability-bot: Deploy job started: enable-trace-sampling rt-canary-3 by raj at 1791234528
noah: also queue lengths show bursty enqueue/drop pattern on rt-12; may be noisy neighbor causing KV cache thrash. request routing may have sent more traffic there
maria: collecting perf samples and nvprof from rt-canary-3 now. will upload flamegraphs + kernel fingerprint mapping
amy: action items: (1) keep 100% traces for 10m, (2) collect nvprof/strace from canary, (3) pin batching config to pre-deploy commit x1a2 for canary, (4) increase KV cache eviction threshold (temporary)
raj: I'll open a quick runbook PR with commands. If we confirm kernel selection change, roll back batching heuristic PR
maria: uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-inference/investigations/1791234567-kernel-fingerprint
amy: thanks. ping me if you see p95 drop below 250ms
noah: adding :eyes: i'll watch node rt-12
maria: note — logs show truncated stack for some kernels because sampling rate at the runtime side went to 0.1% during the window. file a follow-up to lower log-sampler threshold permanently
amy: agreed. follow-up doc in #eng-runtime will list changes
raj: quick patch to heuristics dropped tiny-batch cutoff from 8->4 on canary
maria: can confirm canary p95 back to normal after patch (monitoring upcoming)
observability-bot: Alert resolved: latency_threshold_exceeded prod-rt-eu at 1791234630
amy: closing but will do retrospective to cover observability blind spots
